movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.tagline: Evil found a way out.
movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further

movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
movies.tagline: A new era of evil.
movies.title: Resident Evil

movies.overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.
movies.tagline: You're next
movies.title: Resident Dead

movies.original_title: No dejes a los niños solos
movies.overview: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.
movies.title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone

movies.original_title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
movies.overview: Once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corporation, Raccoon City is now a dying Midwestern town. The company’s exodus left the city a wasteland…with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, the townspeople are forever…changed…and a small group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.
movies.tagline: Witness the beginning of evil.
movies.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City

movies.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.
movies.tagline: Your mommy won't save you.
movies.title: Other Mommy

movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
movies.tagline: Be careful who you wish for…
movies.title: Obsession

movies.overview: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.
movies.tagline: It's Buddy!
movies.title: Buddy

movies.overview: A church group's annual retreat turns deadly when they wander into the wrong part of the Ozark wilderness, and something starts picking them off one by one.  Suspicion falls on Ricky, the troublemaker of the group. But the real threat is far worse.  Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.
movies.tagline: Whatever you do…
movies.title: Don't Move

movies.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
movies.tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung

movies.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
movies.tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.
movies.title: Onslaught

movies.overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.
movies.tagline: Low fidelity. High body count.
movies.title: V/H/S/Mixtape

movies.overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.
movies.title: The Whistler

movies.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
movies.tagline: Survive the hive.
movies.title: Colony

movies.overview: A group of former classmates rent a country house to relax like in the good old days. The modern chalet has everything for a comfortable and fun vacation, including the smart speaker "Alyona". "Alyona" knows how to entertain her guests, she has many "skills". She can solve puzzles, manage the house, and she also knows all the "skeletons in the closet" that friends are hiding. The device invites the company to play the game "Find the Killer" and find out the circumstances of the death of their best friend, who died less than a year ago under strange circumstances.
movies.title: Virtual Assistant

movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
movies.tagline: See how far it goes.
movies.title: Backrooms

movies.overview: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.
movies.tagline: Be careful what you wish for.
movies.title: Coraline

movies.overview: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.
movies.tagline: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of yourself?
movies.title: The Substance

movies.overview: A couple enjoys a romantic weekend in a treehouse suspended more than 20 meters above the ground in a forest. At night, she wakes up with a start and sees her partner fall from the cabin, dying instantly.
movies.title: The Treehouse

movies.overview: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake is drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon - only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath its flawless surface.
movies.tagline: Be the best version of yourself.
movies.title: Shell

movies.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.
movies.tagline: Based on the true case files of the Warrens.
movies.title: The Conjuring

movies.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
movies.tagline: Dance with the devil.
movies.title: Sinners

movies.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
movies.tagline: We all scream.
movies.title: Ice Cream Man

movies.overview: A guard vanished on his first night at an old psych hospital in 2023. His bodycam footage shows unexplainable incidents that continue to baffle investigators.
movies.title: Infirmary

movies.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.tagline: Look fear in the face.
movies.title: Clayface

movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.
movies.tagline: Every family has its demons.
movies.title: Evil Dead Burn

movies.original_title: ธี่หยด: สมิงเขาขวาง
movies.overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.
movies.tagline: Prepare to face the evil within the beast.
movies.title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast

movies.overview: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.
movies.tagline: Mommy loves you to death.
movies.title: Evil Dead Rise

movies.overview: When twin brothers find a mysterious wind-up monkey, a series of outrageous deaths tear their family apart. Twenty-five years later, the monkey begins a new killing spree forcing the estranged brothers to confront the cursed toy.
movies.tagline: Everybody dies. And that's fucked up.
movies.title: The Monkey

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.tagline: The night he came home!
movies.title: Halloween

belongs_to_collection.name: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark Collection

movies.original_title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
movies.overview: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, Halloween night, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a supposedly haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.
movies.tagline: They're not just stories anymore.
movies.title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark

movies.overview: Twenty-eight years after the Rage virus outbreak, a heavily-defended island survives connected to the mainland by a single causeway. When one of the group leaves the island into the dark heart of the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors as well.
movies.tagline: Time didn't heal anything.
movies.title: 28 Years Later

movies.overview: A troupe of ballerinas find themselves fighting for survival as they attempt to escape from a remote inn after their bus breaks down on the way to a dance competition.
movies.tagline: Blood, sweat and tutus.
movies.title: Pretty Lethal

movies.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.
movies.tagline: They were warned...They are doomed...And on Friday the 13th, nothing will save them.
movies.title: Friday the 13th

movies.overview: The haunted Lambert family seeks to uncover the mysterious childhood secret that has left them dangerously connected to the spirit world.
movies.tagline: It will take what you love most.
movies.title: Insidious: Chapter 2

movies.overview: Lorraine and Ed Warren travel to north London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by malicious spirits.
movies.tagline: The next true story from the case files of Ed and Lorraine Warren.
movies.title: The Conjuring 2

movies.original_title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It
movies.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.
movies.tagline: The demonic case that shocked America.
movies.title: The Conjuring: The Devil Made Me Do It

movies.overview: In a dystopian America, fifty teenage boys take part in a deadly annual walking contest, forced to maintain a minimum pace or be executed, until only one survivor remains.
movies.tagline: The task is simple: walk or die.
movies.title: The Long Walk

movies.overview: In 1956 France, a priest is violently murdered, and Sister Irene begins to investigate. She once again comes face-to-face with a powerful evil.
movies.tagline: Confess your sins.
movies.title: The Nun II

movies.overview: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.
movies.tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.
movies.title: The Exorcist

movies.overview: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her six-year-old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
movies.tagline: You'll wish it was only make-believe.
movies.title: Child's Play

movies.overview: Withdrawn and sensitive teenager Carrie White faces bullying from her classmates and abuse from her fanatically pious mother. When she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers, things take a dark and violent turn.
movies.tagline: If you've got a taste for terror...Take Carrie to the prom!
movies.title: Carrie

movies.overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.
movies.tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.
movies.title: Get Out

movies.original_title: ミッシング・チャイルド・ビデオテープ
movies.overview: Keita discovers a missing boy in the woods and soon receives a mysterious videotape from his estranged mother.
movies.title: Missing Child Videotape

movies.original_title: Ready or Not: Here I Come
movies.overview: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.
movies.tagline: Double or nothing.
movies.title: Ready or Not: Here I Come

movies.overview: When tech billionaire Slater King meets cocktail waitress Frida at his fundraising gala, he invites her to join him and his friends on a dream vacation on his private island. But despite the epic setting, beautiful people, ever-flowing champagne, and late-night dance parties, Frida can sense that there’s something sinister hiding beneath the island’s lush façade.
movies.tagline: Are you having a good time?
movies.title: Blink Twice

movies.overview: Recently fired and desperate for work, a troubled young man named Mike agrees to take a position as a night security guard at an abandoned theme restaurant: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria. But he soon discovers that nothing at Freddy's is what it seems.
movies.tagline: Can you survive five nights?
movies.title: Five Nights at Freddy's

movies.overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.
movies.tagline: Witness terror on a gigantic scale.
movies.title: Beware Boiúna

movies.overview: A young bride's wedding night turns into her worst nightmare when her ridiculously rich in-laws force her to play a gruesome game of hide-and-seek.
movies.tagline: A killer game of hide and seek.
movies.title: Ready or Not

movies.overview: During its return to the earth, commercial spaceship Nostromo intercepts a distress signal from a distant planet. When a three-member team of the crew discovers a chamber containing thousands of eggs on the planet, a creature inside one of the eggs attacks an explorer. The entire crew is unaware of the impending nightmare set to descend upon them when the alien parasite planted inside its unfortunate host is birthed.
movies.tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.
movies.title: Alien
